items.stem: What does the Airflow 101 tutorial walk you through?
options: The essential concepts, so you can write your first Dag
items.quote: helping you understand how to write your first Dag

items.stem: In Airflow, what is a Dag?
options: A collection of tasks organized to reflect their relationships and dependencies
A single Python function that runs once a day
A database table that stores task logs
A Docker container that runs the scheduler
items.quote: At its core, a Dag is a collection of tasks organized in a way that reflects their relationships and dependencies.

items.stem: What does an operator represent in Airflow?
options: A user account in the Airflow UI
A schedule such as daily or hourly
items.quote: An operator represents a unit of work in Airflow.

items.stem: Which class do all Airflow operators derive from?
items.quote: All operators derive from the BaseOperator, which includes the essential arguments needed to run tasks in Airflow.

items.stem: How do you define tasks with the TaskFlow API?
options: Write YAML files in the dags/ folder
Create each task in the Airflow UI
Write plain Python functions and decorate them
items.quote: You write plain Python functions, decorate them, and Airflow handles the rest
items.source_title: Pythonic Dags with the TaskFlow API
items.source_heading: Pythonic Dags with the TaskFlow API

items.stem: With TaskFlow, what does Airflow still use behind the scenes to pass data between tasks?
options: A shared CSV file in the dags/ folder
Direct function calls with no storage
items.quote: Airflow still uses XComs and builds a dependency graph
items.source_title: Pythonic Dags with the TaskFlow API

items.stem: Which operator does the data pipeline tutorial use to run SQL against Postgres?
items.quote: This tutorial introduces the SQLExecuteQueryOperator, a flexible and modern way to execute SQL in Airflow.

items.stem: How do you tell Airflow how to connect to the Postgres database before a pipeline writes to it?
options: Hard-code the password in every task
Add the database URL to the Dag tags
Add a connection on the Admin > Connections page
items.quote: In the UI, open the Admin > Connections page and click the + button to add a new connection.

items.stem: How can you keep long SQL statements out of your Dag code?
options: Put them in .sql files in the dags/ folder and pass the file path to sql=
Type them into the Airflow UI at run time
items.quote: You can optionally place these SQL statements in .sql files inside your dags/ folder and pass the file path to the sql= argument.
items.source_heading: Create tables for staging and final data

Why might you include additional context in a prompt?
options: To make the model respond faster
To give the model access to data outside its training data
To lower the cost of every request
To turn off the model's safety checks
items.quote: To give the model access to proprietary data, or any other data outside the data set the model was trained on.

items.stem: What is adding relevant context to a model request sometimes called?
What is the limit on how much data a model can consider in one request called?
items.quote: This memory limit is called a context window, which is defined in terms of tokens
